rationale: Regulator register of licensed non-bank financial actors; diffable roster, authoritative.
Single annual PDF report - retrospective evidence, not a continuous signal surface.
Exchange issuer-announcement feed; board elections of listed banks appear here first.
Queryable CRPS-derived aggregator with directors/ownership; primary automatable layer over the register.
API-accessible normalised CRPS mirror; good change-detection backbone.
CRPS owner agency; notices on register/filing procedure changes affect the whole pipeline.
Single service-catalogue entry on euprava.me; procedural reference, covered by parent, and URL unverified.
Paid bulk CRPS dataset - mine once for the entity universe; requires subscription clearance.
Pan-EU aggregator, stale and redundant with CompanyWall/OpenCorporates; occasional parent-resolution use.
Paid per-company D&B report reseller; low credibility and no continuous signal.
Per-bank governance roster page, fastest-updating per-entity diff target for board changes.
Statutory vacancy-advertising regime page for public bodies; sets the timing rules for public hiring.
Per-session government personnel decisions - richest recurring feed of state-side finance leadership moves.
Core actor ministry newsroom; announces senior finance appointments and payment-system project staffing.
State development bank site; board/executive changes and its own hiring - in-scope financing actor.
State post is a payments actor; management page is the authoritative diffable roster.
Parliamentary committee agendas are the earliest formal signal of regulator leadership changes.
Official gazette - legally authoritative dating of every appointment/dismissal decision.
Job board named by CBCG as an official vacancy channel; employer-filtered banking/payments listings.
Public-officials register is a strong independent cross-check on mandates; URL failed, needs liveness recheck.
NGO-built searchable index over the same appointment universe; useful secondary query surface.
Only Montenegrin banking trade portal; densest coverage of board changes and bank vacancies.
Public broadcaster economy section reports appointment rounds and hiring freezes; fetch failed, recheck liveness.
Covers kadrovski plan detail and state financial institution boards - quantitative org-change signal.
National wire covering sector-wide governance change; URL failed, likely bot defence - recheck.
Second euprava.me service-catalogue entry; procedural context only, sibling of c_304, URL unverified.
